description: 集群数据管理 Skill —— 涵盖数据使用规范、压缩优化、数据共享（ACL）、文件扫描与清理、文件完整性校验、genozip 基因组压缩等全流程。Use when the user asks about: managing data on the HPC cluster, compressing genomic files (fq/bam/vcf), sharing data between users/groups, scanning for large files or cleaning up disk space, checking file integrity (md5/gzip/bam), using genozip, checking disk quota, or any data lifecycle management task on the NCPGR HPC cluster.
